name: Bakunyuu Injoku Reibaishi
source:
The medium Isuzu Meiko is the head of a family that has been raising talented mediums into the world for generations. Together with Touka Shirakoba, an excellent priestess exorcist from the Manjusri Grand Shrine, the busty duo are investigating cases of evil spirits happening all over Japan. 
This is an erotic and occult psychic battle adventure of two women who solve problems with the psychic ability of their bodies!
But there are legions of powerful and evil demons and monsters out there harming people... The two spirit mediums often succumb to the strength of these monsters.
If they do, they will be subjected to hardcore perverted play such as tit squirting, tentacle torture, three-hole torture, intraspecies breeding, super big cocks, foreign object insertion, and whole body swallowing, which is completely outside the realm of reality!
